note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Local screens run the API on SQLite exactly as the app ships. Azure order: sql-log, lost-update, then azure-sql (owner runs the two SQL scripts in the portal Query editor), then azure-demo (its prepare publishes the app after the grant). Mask server name, app host, subscription and account.
prepare: dotnet tool restore
dotnet build ProjectRequests.slnx -v q --nologo
& $env:MG_SVC stop -Name ep03-api
Remove-Item src\ProjectRequests.Api\requests.db* -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Push-Location src\ProjectRequests.Api; dotnet dotnet-ef database update --context SqliteRequestsDbContext; Pop-Location
& $env:MG_SVC start -Name ep03-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5207 -Port 5207

$shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"

$env:RG = 'rg-mglab-net-03'; $nf = 'C:\lab\mgnet\ep03-names.json'; if (-not (Test-Path $nf)) { $n = Get-Random -Minimum 1000 -Maximum 9999; @{ app = "contoso-requests-$n"; sql = "contoso-sql-$n" } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content $nf }; $names = Get-Content $nf | ConvertFrom-Json; $env:APP = $names.app; $env:SQL = $names.sql
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login -o none }  # owner signs in (lab subscription, labadmin)
bash ./deploy/deploy-azure.sh infra

screens.name: azure-sql
steps: Search 'requests' (SQL database in rg-mglab-net-03) and open SQL database 'requests' > Query editor (preview)
Sign in with Microsoft Entra authentication (labadmin); if asked, allow the client IP in the server firewall (remove it again in teardown)
Open/paste deploy/sqlserver-migrations.sql and Run: 'Query succeeded'; optionally Run again to show nothing changes
Run: SELECT MigrationId FROM __EFMigrationsHistory;  -> two rows (..._InitialCreate, ..._AddStatusPriorityIndex)
Run: SELECT * FROM Departments;  -> FIN, IT, OPS
Open/paste deploy/out/grant-app-identity.sql (generated by the infra step, app name filled in) and Run it BEFORE the app's first request
mask: signed-in account in the top bar and the query editor login
